name: Gomenne Angel ~Yokohama Monogatari~
original_name: ごめんねエンジェル 〜横浜物語〜
source:
One day the hero picks up a notebook and it turns out to be a possession of a girl student of St. Francis girls academy where his fiance is teaching. All three of them meet in a cafe, but girl looks very anxious. Her sister disappeared. And we'll help to find her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-january-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天，主角捡到一本笔记本，发现失主是圣弗朗西斯女子学院的一名学生，而自己的未婚妻正好在该校任教。三人在咖啡馆见面，少女却显得十分焦虑：她的姐姐失踪了。主角将帮助她寻找姐姐。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-january-1992.html]vndbreview[/url]]
